title: Def. 1.1 tested on product functions: t^{-n}∫ g(t⁻¹(y−x))β(S) dV → θ β(T) ∫_T g dH^n
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N (V : Varifold N n U), x ∈ ℝ^N, T ∈ G(N,n) and θ ∈ ℝ, and suppose HasTangentPlane V x T θ (Simon Ch. 8, Def. 1.1: x ∈ U, θ > 0, and ∫ f dV_{x,t} → θ ∫ f dv(T) as t ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)), where V_{x,t} = rescaledMeasure V x t and v(T) = planeVarifoldMeasure T). Then for every g ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ) and every continuous β : G(N,n) → ℝ, t^{-n} ∫ g(t⁻¹(y − x)) β(S) dV(y,S) → θ · (β(T) · ∫_{T.plane} g dH^n) as t → 0⁺, where t^{-n} = (t⁻¹)^n, H^n = μHE[n], and all integrals are Bochner integrals (the first with respect to V.measure).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → ∀ (g : C_c(Euclidean N, ℝ)) (β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ z, g (t⁻¹ • (z.1 - x)) * β z.2 ∂V.measure) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (θ * (β T * ∫ y in (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), g y ∂μHE[n])))
